newsitem.title: SPAIN: Seventeen dead, 50 injured in Spain train wreck.
newsitem.headline: Seventeen dead, 50 injured in Spain train wreck.

text.p: At least 17 people were killed and 50 injured on Monday when a passenger train derailed in northern Spain, officials said.
Authorities feared some victims were still trapped in the wreckage and said the death count could go higher. Eighteen of the injured were listed in serious condition, state television reported.

The train, carrying 248 passengers, many returning home from a long holiday weekend, was travelling from Barcelona to Irun on Spain's border with France when two of its four carriages slid off the track and rolled over, said a spokesman for the Spanish rail company RENFE.
"The train derailed. People were trapped. Police and Civil Guardsmen are trying to get them out," said Mariano Arduenza, a local official.
The accident occurred near the village of Uharte Arakil in Navarre province, about 32 km (19 miles) northwest of the city of Pamplona.
Dozens of ambulances rushed to the scene from nearby towns, and rescue crews struggled to pull bodies from the wreckage.
The cause of the derailment was not immediately known. "An investigation will get under way as soon as we have our people on the scene," the RENFE spokesman said.
